findings.claim: The tool allowlist now grants two independent aliases for the same three Engram operations (mcp__engram__mem_search/mem_get_observation/mem_save and mcp__plugin_engram_engram__*). If both servers resolve in the same session, the executor can save through one namespace and search/get through the other, so recall of just-saved observations becomes dependent on which alias the model happens to pick rather than on the data — a nondeterministic memory path that no assertion in the candidate constrains. The change adds no directive telling the executor which alias to prefer when both are present.
